attributes.honesty: Keeping promises and telling difficult truths; no reward for merely speaking.
attributes.compassion: Attending to another's needs without deciding for them.
attributes.curiosity: A meaningful experiment or discovery; walking or asking routine questions earns nothing.
attributes.mischief: Playful disruption, tricks, or delight in absurdity; not inherently bad.
attributes.generosity: Giving something wanted without demanding a return.

loft_invited.instruction: Only after the bakehouse keeper explicitly invites the player to use the loft.

nook_shown.instruction: Only after someone shows the player the hollow behind the willow, or the player finds it by deliberate investigation.

bell_mended.instruction: Set after the player fits the brace into the two clapper slots. Record the changed tower description. The repair is an accomplishment, not an ending.

boat_ready.instruction: Set after the player seals the boat seam with pitch and floats it successfully. Record its new condition in the landing description. No voyage is required.

achievements.text: The bell finds its clear note again. The afternoon continues.
The boat floats evenly, ready for whatever journey someone wants.

road_departure.instruction: Only if the player explicitly chooses to leave the village for good. Walking to the crossroads is not enough.
road_departure.text: The road carries you beyond Bellweather, with the rest of the day still yours.

enough_for_today.instruction: Only if the player explicitly says they want to stop playing or end their adventure. Resting, waiting, or sitting is not quitting.
enough_for_today.text: You leave Bellweather to its own afternoon. Your adventure has ended for today.

river_departure.instruction: Only if the player explicitly chooses to take the boat downstream and leave Bellweather for good. A trial trip or a float nearby does not end the adventure.
river_departure.text: The boat carries you around the river bend. Bellweather slips out of sight behind the willows.

schedules.fact: Oswin has brought his tea to the bench on the green.
schedules.hears: You have brought your tea to the bench on the green. Enjoy sitting here. You may try a new name for the dandelion patch if someone happens to be present. Nobody needs to stop what they are doing.

schedules.fact: Nella has put a small lantern beside the river landing as the afternoon light softens.
schedules.hears: You have put a small lantern beside the landing. You are watching the current and deciding whether to float a leaf. If a visitor is here, company is welcome; if not, enjoy the river on your own.
